fields.description: Issue dated Saturday, April 2, 1927. Prominent editorials criticize City of Miami public-utility and transportation franchise contracts, especially those involving Florida Power & Light Company, arguing they enable excessive rates and could financially endanger the city; discussion includes municipal politics and upcoming city elections. Additional content includes commentary on dividing Florida, state politics (including Governor John W. Martin and Park Trammell), local civic and community news, entertainment listings, society and sports notes, real-estate and tourism-related items, and advertisements and notices (including oil and gas lease promotions and legal notices).
